put.description:
Update (merge or replace) existing dataset data. This function currently does not support deleting rows.
If replace is true, entire existing dataset data is replaced with the new data in input.
If replace is false,
  • If keys are not given, the input data is appended to the existing dataset.
  • If keys are given then the following flow explains the operation
    For each row in the input data:
    • The rows with same values for all the keys are replaced with input row.
    • Other rows are appended to the existing dataset
    Error raised when:
    • If there are duplicate rows in input data with same key values
    • If any key passed in keys is not present as a column in the input data
NOTE: This directly updates the dataset and all drafts are removed.

import sys
import json
from datetime import datetime
import re

ENTITY_TYPE_PRIORITY = {
    'NETWORK_ELEMENT': 1,
    'DB_SERVER': 5,
    'APPLICATION_COMPONENT': 9,
    'APPLICATION': 10 
}

regexc = r"(CFX\d{2,14})"
regexc = re.compile(regexc, re.IGNORECASE)
kwargs = {}

def main(incident_payload, resolver_config, incident):
    print("main::source:%s,sourceKey:%s" % (incident.source, incident.sourceKey))
    incident_json = json.loads(incident_payload)
    #print("main::incident:%s, incident_json:%s" % (incident, incident_json))
    cfx_incident_id = None
    incident.source = "Atlassian Jira"
    incident.sourceKey = incident_json.get("issue").get("key")
    incident.label = incident.sourceKey
    incident.summary = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("summary")
    incident.reporter = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("reporter").get("name")
    incident.creator = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("creator").get("name")
    created = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("created")
    if created is not None:
        incident.created = round(datetime.strptime(created, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z').timestamp() * 1000)
    updated = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("updated")
    incident.updated = round(datetime.strptime(updated, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z').timestamp() * 1000)
    incident.assignee = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("assignee")
    if incident.assignee is not None:
        incident.assignee = incident.assignee.get("name")
    else:
        incident.assignee = None

    incident.state = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("status").get("name")
    if (incident_json.get("issue_event_type_name") == "issue_resolved") or (incident.state in ["Closed", "Resolved"]):
        incident.resolved_user = incident_json.get("user").get("name")
        resolved_at = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("resolutiondate")
        incident.resolved_at = round(datetime.strptime(resolved_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z').timestamp() * 1000)
        incident.resolution_code = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("resolution").get("id")
    else:
        incident.resolved_user = None
        incident.resolved_at = None
        incident.resolution_code = None

    priority = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("priority").get("name")
    if priority == "Highest":
        incident.priority = "1 - Critical"
    elif priority == "High":
        incident.priority = "2 - High"
    elif priority == "Medium":
        incident.priority = "3 - Moderate"
    elif priority == "Low":
        incident.priority = "4 - Low"
    elif priority == "Lowest":
        incident.priority = "5 - Planning"

    
    if incident.state == "Closed":
        incident.closed_user = incident_json.get("user").get("name")
        closed_at = incident_json.get("issue").get("fields").get("updated")
        # 2020-02-03T20:15:18.447-0800
        incident.closed_at = round(datetime.strptime(closed_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z').timestamp() * 1000)
    else:
        incident.closed_user = None
        incident.closed_at = None

    if incident_json.get("comment") is not None:
        incident.comments = incident_json.get("comment").get("body")
    else:
        incident.comments = None

    # Set the payload dictionary
    incident.payloadDictionary = incident_json
    print("main::cfx_incident_id:%s,source:%s,sourceKey:%s,attributes:%s" % (cfx_incident_id,incident.source, incident.sourceKey, incident.attributes))
